title: LearnOutcome
description: What a learn step reports, on `POST /learn` and as the `learn` field of a completion that carried one (`learn_outcome`, server-task.cpp). A refusal inside the step (no such slot, no loaded adapter, a missing backward) is `success: false` with `failure`, not an HTTP error.
